sources.entry: OpenStreetMap - Collaborative project to create a free editable map of the world. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 Ruby

summary.one_liner: The Ruby on Rails application that runs the OpenStreetMap website, its editing API, Browse pages, and GPX upload features.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the Ruby on Rails codebase behind the OpenStreetMap website and API. It covers user accounts, diary entries, and user-to-user messaging. It also provides the XML- and JSON-based editing API, the Browse pages as a web front-end to OSM data, and GPX trace uploads, browsing, and API. The README states that a full installation also depends on separate map tile and geocoding services, which the default setup takes from public providers for development and testing.
use_cases: develop or test changes to the OSM website
host a local OSM editing API
browse and share GPX GPS traces
how_to_run: See INSTALL.md for full installation details
notable: Powers the live openstreetmap.org website and API
Includes XML and JSON editing API
Built-in GPX trace upload and browsing
Local Chapters listing pulled from osm-community-index
caveats: Installation has a large number of dependencies, per the README
Full functionality requires separate tile and geocoding servers not included here
